subject: Horizon-lock: acceptance timing & clearance path (EdenCare)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: EdenCare Procurement <procurement@edencarehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon-lock: acceptance timing & clearance path (EdenCare)

Hi Lydia / EdenCare procurement team,

Thanks again for the constructive call yesterday. I wanted to put a concise path forward in writing so we can avoid further drift on the MAP and lock a practical acceptance horizon. The key constraints we heard: internal procurement window, security review queue, and a requested on-prem audit for retention settings.

Summary of current state:
- MAP v2 attached (EdenCare_MAP_v2.xlsx) reflects target go-live 2026-09-01 with full acceptance by 2026-09-15.
- Procurement indicated an internal approval bottleneck (legal + finance) that could add 2–3 weeks.
- Security asked for audit-log samples and a short architecture walk-through.

Three options to unblock (pick one for immediate planning):
A) Staggered acceptance (preferred): Canary: enable subset of users (pilot) 2026-08-25; full acceptance window 2026-09-08–2026-09-15. Requires sign-off on pilot scope and acceptance criteria.
B) Baseline shift: move go-live to 2026-09-22 with no pilot. We will hold configuration and commit dedicated capacity starting 2026-09-15.
C) Escrow & conditional SLA: maintain current go-live but agree to a temporary SLA credit if procurement extends beyond 2 weeks. (Sales leadership approval required).

Immediate asks:
- Lydia: which option do you want us to plan for by end-of-week?
- Procurement: can you confirm the expected legal/finance approval date range?
- Marissa/Ben/Priya: proposed owners for pilot scope, infra enablement, and acceptance criteria (see acceptance-criteria.md).

Attachments: EdenCare_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf, acceptance-criteria.md

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@edencarehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon-lock: acceptance timing & clearance path (EdenCare)

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the clear summary. Short answers and context: legal + finance are on a two-week rotation and we expect a signoff window between 2026-08-23 and 2026-09-03. Security is already queued; they asked for sample audit logs and a short architecture session next week.

We need the following from Redwood to help accelerate internally:
- Audit log samples showing retention controls and access trails (PDF ok).
- A 30–45 minute architecture walkthrough for our InfoSec on Wed 2026-08-13 or Thu 2026-08-14.
- Confirmation that a pilot (canary) can be scoped down to a single business unit and reversed quickly.

If legal does not sign by 2026-08-23, we will likely have to move the final acceptance out ~3 weeks. For planning, please prepare option A (pilot) as the primary mitigation.

Thanks,
Lydia
Procurement Lead | EdenCare Health
procurement@edencarehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@edencarehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon-lock: acceptance timing & clearance path (EdenCare)

On Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700, Lydia Park wrote:
> Appreciate the clear summary...

Thanks Lydia — we can absolutely support option A (pilot) and will prepare the artifacts InfoSec requested. Quick operational notes and proposed mitigations from our side: 

- Pilot scope: 1 BU (30 users), read-only ingestion for first 48 hours, then normal telemetry. Pilot rollback automated (feature flag) — Ben will own the rollback runbook.
- Acceptance gating: pilot health checks (latency < 200ms p95, successful ingest rate >= 95%, security checklist pass). Detailed criteria in acceptance-criteria.md.
- Procurement contingency: if legal approval slips past 2026-08-23, we propose a 2-week baseline shift with an auto-canary window on 2026-09-08. This buys the team time while keeping momentum.
- Commercial ask: if the final fully-signed acceptance moves beyond 2026-09-15, we can offer a one-time operational credit (TBD) to offset extended ramp costs. Marissa to coordinate with finance for exact numbers.

Action owners:
- Ben: prepare rollback + pilot infra and audit log samples (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf) — due 2026-08-13 EOD.
- Priya: draft the commercial contingency (credit structure) and escalation note for Sales Ops — due 2026-08-14.
- Soojin: capture final agreed baseline in the MAP and send to EdenCare once pilot scope is confirmed.

Lydia — if the dates above look reasonable, please confirm pilot scope and which date you prefer for the architecture walk-through (8/13 or 8/14).

—Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Quick technical note / mitigation options: 

- Audit logs: attached sample (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf) includes access trails and retention policy snapshot. We'll redact customer-specific tokens before sharing.
- Pilot infra: we can stand up a dedicated GPU pool for the pilot window (cost estimate attached in MAP). This will isolate load and make rollback safe; provisioning lead time ~48 hours.
- SLA credit proposal: recommend 10% credit on monthly usage for the first month past the original acceptance date, capped at USD 15k — ask Priya for commercial approval.

I will action the rollback runbook and schedule a short IR run-through with EdenCare during the walkthrough.

—Ben

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon-lock: acceptance timing & clearance path (EdenCare)

Lydia — thank you for confirming the internal timelines on the call today. Per agreement, here is the consolidated path and escalation triggers (this email serves as the official MAP update):

Agreed baseline (pilot-first):
- Pilot activation: 2026-08-25 (30 users, single BU). Owner: Ben Carter.
- Pilot monitoring window: 2026-08-25 — 2026-08-27. Acceptance checks documented in acceptance-criteria.md.
- Full acceptance target (new baseline if legal signs by 2026-08-23): 2026-09-08 — 2026-09-15.
- Fallback baseline (if legal not signed by 2026-08-23): move final acceptance window to 2026-09-29 and trigger Sales leadership review on 2026-08-26 for commercial offsets.

Open action items (owners & due dates):
- Ben: finalized audit-log sample + rollback runbook (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf) — due 2026-08-13 (completed).
- Priya: commercial contingency (SLA credit wording) — due 2026-08-14 (in progress).
- Soojin: updated MAP with pilot dates and signature request to DocuSign — will send 2026-08-19.

Escalation: if EdenCare procurement does not provide signed PO by 2026-08-23, Redwood will escalate to Sales leadership for approval of commercial offsets and to decide whether to reserve dedicated capacity ahead of the fallback baseline.

Next steps: Lydia, please confirm preferred architecture walkthrough slot (8/13 or 8/14) and confirm the legal signoff ETA when available. Once pilot scope is confirmed, I will send the updated MAP and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks all — I'll follow up with the updated MAP tomorrow.

Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
